verdict.rationale: Requesty is a unified, OpenAI-compatible gateway, so developers keep one request format across 300+ models. It also documents translating a single web-search tool definition into each provider's format, and it enforces consistent structured-output behavior regardless of the underlying provider. However, the pack never explicitly documents general function/tool calling or how arbitrary tool schemas and tool-call responses are normalized across providers, so the core story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit function-calling documentation, evidence of cross-provider tool-call schema normalization (including streamed tool calls), independent or hands-on corroboration.
